subject: Post-call recap & VP/CTO alignment request
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex King <alex.king@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and to make it easy to pick the right follow-up: 

- Key drivers: faster inference for customer-facing features (latency target ~60–80ms p95), consistent model behaviour across dev/prod, and tighter cost controls for peak traffic.
- Primary stakeholders: Jordan (CTO) for architecture impact, Product (you) for success criteria, and Ops for security/retention.
- Success criteria you mentioned: <500ms cold start for typical flows, predictable unit cost under $0.005/token for high-volume endpoints, and SOC2 evidence for procurement.

Suggested next step: a 30–45m VP/CTO alignment call (Jordan + your leadership) so we can:
1) surface a technical runbook and architecture implications,
2) confirm a pilot scope and runway, and
3) discuss procurement cadence (SOW/PO timeline).

I pulled together a short mutual action plan and a one-pager that maps workloads -> latency/cost tradeoffs (attached). If this looks right, can you share Jordan’s availability or point me to the right exec? Below are a couple of slots from our side next week.

- Wed 8/23 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thu 8/24 14:00–14:45 PT
- Fri 8/25 09:00–09:45 PT

If none of those work, send a couple times and we’ll flex.

Attachments: MAP_NovaCorp_20280815.pdf (mutual action plan), SOW_template_redwood_v1.docx (SOW template)

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Jordan can do limited windows next week but prefers mornings PT. Two options he’s offered:
- Wed 8/23 09:00–09:30 PT (tight)
- Fri 8/25 09:00–09:45 PT

I’m copying Jordan here — Jordan, Mateo is proposing a VP/CTO alignment + tech runbook walk that should help us validate impact to our infra and procurement needs. Can you confirm which of the above works? If neither, happy to propose additional times.

Thanks Alex — and hi Jordan, great to meet you over email.

We can absolutely make a tight morning window work. To make the call as actionable as possible I propose this agenda (30–35m):
- 5m: quick intros and goals
- 10m: tech runbook overview (latency targets, KV cache strategy, rollout plan) — Karthik will lead
- 10m: pilot scope & success metrics (owner, timeline, expected cost delta) — Mateo
- 5m: procurement next steps & SOW timeline — Marissa

Jordan — based on Alex’s note, we can do either Wed 8/23 09:00 PT or Fri 8/25 09:00 PT. If you confirm one, I’ll send a calendar invite and drop a 1-page exec brief in the event.

Quick ask for the call so we prepare:
- Who will be your engineering lead (name + email)?
- Any hard constraints we should know (data residency, KMS/HSM, network egress rules)?

I’ve attached the MAP and a draft SOW for procurement visibility.
